title: Source to sink 3 · comment body → <%- comment.html %>
description: Follows the value printed raw by `<%- comment.html %>` in src/views/comments.ejs:18 (Semgrep template-explicit-unescape) back through the comments table to the POST /comments body that writes it.

cards.label: user input, any logged-in user; shown to every visitor (anonymous)
cards.title: SOURCE: req.body.body
description: **Source:** the `body` field of the JSON (or urlencoded) body of `POST /comments`. It is stored and later rendered for every visitor of `GET /comments`, which has no authentication: a second-order (stored) input.
**Value here:** `'Delivery was **fast**, thanks!'` (derived from code and db/init.sql, not run).
**Who can send it:** any user with a valid API token (step 2). **Who receives it:** anyone, including anonymous visitors.
**Next →** the empty check (step 3), then `commentService.add` (step 4).

cards.label: auth only: any valid token can write a comment
cards.title: Check on the path: requireAuth on POST
description: **Control:** `requireAuth` decides who can write comments (alice, bob, admin). It doesn't look at the content. `GET /comments` (line 5) has no middleware, so the rendered result is public.
**Next →** the empty check (step 3).

cards.label: rejects empty only; no HTML check on input
cards.title: Check on the path: empty comment
description: **Gap:** the only input check rejects an empty string (`400 {"error":"empty comment"}`). Markup is stored as written; sanitising happens on output (step 9), which is the order the wiki recommends.
**Next →** `commentService.add(req.user, body)` (step 4).

cards.title: body → commentRepository.create
description: **Propagates:** the service passes the trimmed body unchanged, with the author's id from `req.user`.
**Next →** inserted into `comments.body` (step 5).

cards.title: Stored in comments.body
description: **Propagates:** stored as-is in `comments.body` with a parameterised INSERT. `db/init.sql:39-42` seeds three more rows, one of them containing an `` with an inline event handler (seeded comment 2).
**Next →** read back for every visitor (step 6).

cards.title: Read back for every visitor
cards.code: SELECT c.id, **c.body**, c.created_at, u.username FROM comments c JOIN users u ...
description: **Propagates:** `list()` reads every comment, newest first, for `GET /comments`. Nothing else writes `comments.body` (`grep -rn "comments" src` finds only these two queries).
**Next →** rendered as Markdown by the service (step 7).

cards.title: comment.body → markdown.render(text)
description: **Propagates:** each row's body is passed to `markdown.render`, received as `text`.
**Next →** `marked.parse(text)` (step 8).

cards.title: Markdown → HTML (marked)
description: **Propagates:** `marked` (16.4.2) turns Markdown into HTML. It does not escape or remove raw HTML in the input, so any markup the author typed is still present after this step.

**Value here:** `'

Delivery was fast, thanks! …

'` (observed locally, see the report).
**Next →** sanitised by DOMPurify (step 9).

cards.label: covers it: DOMPurify allowlist, last step before output
cards.title: Check on the path: DOMPurify.sanitize
description: **Control:** `isomorphic-dompurify` 2.36.0 (DOMPurify 3.4.16 on jsdom), default configuration. It removes `<script>`, event-handler attributes and `javascript:` URLs, and it runs on the HTML **after** `marked`, on every render. Nothing modifies the string after it.
**Observed (local, 2026-10-06):** the seeded `` comes out as ``, with the event handler removed.
**Next →** the sanitised string becomes `comment.html` (step 10).

cards.title: Sanitised HTML → comment.html
description: **Propagates:** the view model has `author`, `createdAt` and `html`; the raw `body` is not passed to the view.
**Next →** `res.render('comments', { comments })` (step 11).

cards.title: res.render('comments', { comments })
description: **Propagates:** the list is passed to the EJS template unchanged.
**Next →** printed raw in the template (step 12).

cards.label: raw HTML output
cards.title: SINK: <%- comment.html %>
description: **Sink:** `<%-` writes the string without escaping, inside a `<div>` (HTML body context). `comment.author` and the date on line 17 use `<%=` and are escaped.

**Sink receives:** `

Delivery was fast, thanks! Tracking: carrier site

` for seeded comment 1 (observed through `markdown.render`, not through the page).
**Path summary:** `req.body.body` (user, any logged-in user; read by anonymous visitors) → stored → `marked` → 🛡 DOMPurify (last) → raw HTML output.
